rounds.text: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd trades at an extreme valuation of 412x P/E, meaning the current price of ₹ 236 completely discounts any future optimism [E1, E2]. Fundamental returns are exceptionally weak, evidenced by a dismal 1% median return on equity over 3 years, a low 3.91% ROE against the sector benchmark, and a low interest coverage ratio [E9, E23, E52]. The company is bleeding cash, posting a negative operating cash flow of Rs -7.29 Cr and a negative free cash flow of Rs -7.34 Cr in March 2026, directly contradicting any stability suggested by its operating margins [E30, E31]. Furthermore, financial health is worsening as borrowings more than doubled to Rs 350.54 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 169.89 Cr a year earlier, while promoters have aggressively slashed their stake by 19.71 percentage points down to 33.75% and pledged 30.4% of their holding [E34, E36, E55]. Conceded: the company displays strong 5-year compounded sales growth of 59% and a market-beating relative-strength rating of 81 [E14, E43].
